description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail a save against an effect that would incapacitate, paralyse, dominate, or kill you.

Whatever it is trying to do to you, your nervous system declined the offer some years ago.

Treat that failure as a success, or a critical failure as an ordinary failure. You then gain 2 Tally and are fatigued until you next rest. This works on effects of any level, including those a creature of your level normally cannot refuse.

cinderfall.incomplete: Treats a failed save (vs. incapacitate/paralyze/dominate/kill) as a success, and a critical failure as a failure; gains 2 Tally, fatigued until rest. AdjustDegreeOfSuccess only ever shifts the degree of a roll that already happened for the better in the real precedent found (success to critical-success) -- converting an actual failure into a success is the one direction it cannot do. Deadhand's Tally is also entirely homebrew with zero schema footprint.
